habits.boundary_condition: Treat the pool and exercise facility as durable hotel-level priorities; do not infer requirements about pool location, pool type, hot tubs, or specific room amenities unless stated for the current trip.
habits.condition: When searching for a hotel, especially when comparing amenity packages.
habits.default_action: Prefer hotels that offer both a pool and an on-site fitness center or gym.
habits.exception_condition: Relax either preference when the user explicitly waives it or when stronger current-trip constraints make a hotel without one of these amenities preferable.
habits.name: hotel_pool_and_fitness_priority
habits.rationale: Three independent hotel dialogues repeatedly pair a pool with a place to exercise, fitness center, or gym, supporting a coherent reusable amenity preference.
